purpose: Development-only exhaustive edge-count sweep and prespecified mechanism controls.
sweep: Every distinct number of weakest nonzero interactions removed, including zero and all. Fields and original normalization unchanged; scoring always full original objective.
training_objective: Mean full original normalized energy on the same 16 separate training groups. All 2-angle and split-field/coupling 3-angle fits use exactly 768 objective evaluations and include the original angles in the initial population.
limitations: Exploratory selection on old development cases, not final validation.
Pointwise paired uncertainty does not correct the many sparsity comparisons; do not declare an optimal percentage from the maximum.
Ideal probabilities are exact statevector results; finite-shot success is a mathematical expectation, not an observed count.
No secure ML-KEM or quantum-advantage claim.
